decisions.reason: A multi-model formwork profile line with its own web page is a visible investment close to the core offer, so the firm will persist with it in an expanding market.

The automated distributor flow control matches the announced push toward automation and draws on in-house R&D, so it is strategically central and worth defending even though it is only mentioned on the website.
The shuttering magnet line is a low-cost extension of the established magnetic formwork range, and any weak early sales can be put down to the normal ramp-up time.
The magnetic formwork strips are a multi-model line with a dedicated page, which signals public commitment and fits the firm's core business.
